data.content_ref: inline:The stated refutation condition is self-defeating: it says the compatibility relation is refuted if a single evaluation with perturbed items is 'functionally indistinguishable' from a multi-evaluation longitudinal transfer test. But 'functionally indistinguishable' is not defined, and on any reasonable reading (same statistical power to detect coincidence, same counterfactual structure), the two *are* functionally indistinguishable in the epistemically relevant sense — both probe whether performance generalizes beyond the training-equivalent distribution. The target asserts compatibility (limit vs. edge-of-limit) but provides no criterion for distinguishing 'operates at the edge of a limit' from 'circumvents the limit entirely,' and its own refutation condition would almost certainly be met under any precise definition, making the claimed relation trivially refutable rather than substantive.
